description_en: Queries the status of the advanced application monitoring feature or configures this feature for an application that is deployed in an Elastic Compute Service (ECS) or Kubernetes cluster
description_zh: 调用SwitchAdvancedMonitoring接口查询ECS和K8s集群中应用高级监控开关状态及控制接口
name: SwitchAdvancedMonitoring

parameters.help_en: The ID of the application for which you want to query or configure the advanced application monitoring feature
parameters.help_zh: 需要查询或者修改应用高级监控功能的应用ID
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the advanced application monitoring feature. Valid values:

true: enables the advanced application monitoring feature.
false: disables the advanced application monitoring feature.

If you call this operation to query the status of the advanced application monitoring feature, you do not need to specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
应用高级监控的开关，可选参数如下：

true：打开。
false：关闭。

在查询应用高级监控状态时，此参数不必填写
parameters.name: enable_advanced_monitoring
